---
title: "301 Map"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(leaflet)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(ggplot2)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

ht <- read.csv("HT_2013-2025.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
               na.strings = c("", "NA", "NULL")) |>
  filter(ACTUAL_COUNT > 0) |>   # drops zero rows
  mutate(
    POPULATION_GROUP_CODE = coalesce(POPULATION_GROUP_CODE, "Unknown"),
    POPULATION_GROUP_DESC = coalesce(POPULATION_GROUP_DESC, "Unknown")
  )

years <- sort(unique(ht$DATA_YEAR))

pop_lookup <- ht |>
  distinct(POPULATION_GROUP_CODE, POPULATION_GROUP_DESC) |>
  arrange(POPULATION_GROUP_CODE)
pop_choices <- setNames(pop_lookup$POPULATION_GROUP_CODE,
                        paste(pop_lookup$POPULATION_GROUP_CODE, "-", pop_lookup$POPULATION_GROUP_DESC))

# ploys
states_sf <- suppressMessages(states(cb = TRUE, resolution = "20m", year = 2022)) |>
  st_transform(4326)

metric_choices <- c(
  "Total offenses (actual count)" = "actual",
  "Number of agencies reporting"  = "n_agencies",
  "% Commercial Sex Acts"         = "pct_csa",
  "% Involuntary Servitude"       = "pct_is"
)


fmt <- function(x) prettyNum(x, big.mark = ",")

summarise_states <- function(df) {
  df |>
    group_by(STATE_NAME) |>
    summarise(
      n_agencies = n_distinct(ORI),
      actual     = sum(ACTUAL_COUNT),
      csa        = sum(ACTUAL_COUNT[OFFENSE_SUBCAT_NAME == "Commercial Sex Acts"]),
      isv        = sum(ACTUAL_COUNT[OFFENSE_SUBCAT_NAME == "Involuntary Servitude"]),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(pct_csa = csa / actual * 100,
           pct_is  = isv / actual * 100)
}

make_pal <- function(v, diverging) {
  na_col <- "#d9d9d9"
  v <- v[is.finite(v)]
  if (length(v) == 0) v <- c(0, 1)
  if (diverging) {
    m <- max(abs(v), 1)
    return(colorNumeric("RdBu", domain = c(-m, m), reverse = TRUE, na.color = na_col))
  }
  rng <- range(v)
  if (diff(rng) == 0) rng <- rng + c(0, 1)
  brks <- unique(as.numeric(quantile(v, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 6))))
  if (length(brks) < 3) return(colorNumeric("YlOrRd", domain = rng, na.color = na_col))
  colorBin("YlOrRd", domain = rng, bins = brks, na.color = na_col)
}

ui <- fluidPage(
  tags$style(".leaflet-container { background: #ffffff; }"),
  titlePanel("Human Trafficking Reports by State"),
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      width = 3,
      radioButtons("mode", "View",
                   c("One year" = "one",
                     "All years combined" = "all",
                     "Change between two years" = "chg")),
      conditionalPanel(
        "input.mode == 'one'",
        sliderInput("year", "Year", min = min(years), max = max(years),
                    value = max(years), step = 1, sep = "",
                    animate = animationOptions(interval = 1500))
      ),
      conditionalPanel(
        "input.mode == 'chg'",
        fluidRow(
          column(6, selectInput("y1", "From", years, selected = min(years))),
          column(6, selectInput("y2", "To",   years, selected = max(years)))
        ),
        helpText("Red = increase, blue = decrease. For the % metrics, change is in percentage points.")
      ),
      selectInput("metric", "Color map by", metric_choices),
      hr(),
      selectizeInput("agency", "Agency type (blank = all)",
                     choices = sort(unique(ht$AGENCY_TYPE_NAME)), multiple = TRUE),
      selectizeInput("pop", "Population group (blank = all)",
                     choices = pop_choices, multiple = TRUE),
      hr(),
      strong("Jump to:"),
      div(actionButton("v_us", "Contiguous US"),
          actionButton("v_ak", "Alaska"),
          actionButton("v_hi", "Hawaii")),
      br(),
      helpText("Hover a state for its numbers. Click a state for breakdowns by agency type, ",
               "population group, and a year-by-year trend."),
      helpText(textOutput("unmapped"))
    ),
    mainPanel(
      width = 9,
      leafletOutput("map", height = "560px"),
      hr(),
      h4(textOutput("detail_title")),
      fluidRow(
        column(6, h5("By agency type"), tableOutput("tbl_type")),
        column(6, h5("By population group"), tableOutput("tbl_pop"))
      ),
      fluidRow(
        column(6, plotOutput("plot_off", height = "250px")),
        column(6, plotOutput("plot_ag",  height = "250px"))
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  #agency-type / population-group filters
  base <- reactive({
    d <- ht
    if (length(input$agency)) d <- filter(d, AGENCY_TYPE_NAME %in% input$agency)
    if (length(input$pop))    d <- filter(d, POPULATION_GROUP_CODE %in% input$pop)
    d
  })
  
  map_df <- reactive({
    d <- base()
    m <- input$metric
    
    if (input$mode %in% c("one", "all")) {
      if (input$mode == "one") d <- filter(d, DATA_YEAR == input$year)
      summarise_states(d) |>
        mutate(
          value = .data[[m]],
          label = sprintf(
            paste0("<b>%s</b><br>Agencies reporting: %s<br>Total offenses: %s",
                   "<br>Commercial Sex Acts: %s (%.0f%%)",
                   "<br>Involuntary Servitude: %s (%.0f%%)"),
            STATE_NAME, fmt(n_agencies), fmt(actual),
            fmt(csa), pct_csa, fmt(isv), pct_is)
        )
    } else {
      y1 <- as.integer(input$y1); y2 <- as.integer(input$y2)
      s <- full_join(summarise_states(filter(d, DATA_YEAR == y1)),
                     summarise_states(filter(d, DATA_YEAR == y2)),
                     by = "STATE_NAME", suffix = c("_1", "_2"))
      for (v in c("n_agencies", "actual", "csa", "isv"))
        for (k in 1:2) {
          col <- paste0(v, "_", k)
          s[[col]][is.na(s[[col]])] <- 0
        }
      s$value <- s[[paste0(m, "_2")]] - s[[paste0(m, "_1")]]
      s$label <- sprintf(
        paste0("<b>%s</b> (%d to %d)",
               "<br>Agencies reporting: %s to %s (%+.0f)",
               "<br>Total offenses: %s to %s (%+.0f)",
               "<br>Commercial Sex Acts: %s to %s",
               "<br>Involuntary Servitude: %s to %s",
               "<br>%% Commercial Sex Acts: %.0f%% to %.0f%%"),
        s$STATE_NAME, y1, y2,
        fmt(s$n_agencies_1), fmt(s$n_agencies_2), s$n_agencies_2 - s$n_agencies_1,
        fmt(s$actual_1), fmt(s$actual_2), s$actual_2 - s$actual_1,
        fmt(s$csa_1), fmt(s$csa_2),
        fmt(s$isv_1), fmt(s$isv_2),
        s$pct_csa_1, s$pct_csa_2)
      s
    }
  })
  
  # Base map, drawn once
  output$map <- renderLeaflet({
    # No basemap tiles: the state polygons are the map, so no tile provider
    # (and no API key) is needed.
    leaflet(options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 2)) |>
      setView(-96, 38, 4)
  })
  
  # Redraw state shapes whenever the data or controls change
  observe({
    s   <- map_df()
    shp <- left_join(states_sf, s, by = c("NAME" = "STATE_NAME"))
    no_data <- is.na(shp$label)
    shp$label[no_data] <- paste0("<b>", shp$NAME[no_data], "</b><br>No data")
    
    pal <- make_pal(shp$value, diverging = input$mode == "chg")
    legend_title <- names(metric_choices)[metric_choices == input$metric]
    if (input$mode == "chg") legend_title <- paste("Change:", legend_title)
    
    leafletProxy("map", data = shp) |>
      clearShapes() |>
      clearControls() |>
      addPolygons(
        layerId = ~NAME,
        fillColor = ~pal(value), fillOpacity = 0.8,
        color = "white", weight = 1,
        label = lapply(shp$label, HTML),
        highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#333333", bringToFront = TRUE)
      ) |>
      addLegend("bottomright", pal = pal, values = ~value,
                title = legend_title, na.label = "No data", opacity = 0.8)
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$v_us, leafletProxy("map") |> setView(-96, 38, 4))
  observeEvent(input$v_ak, leafletProxy("map") |> setView(-150, 64, 3))
  observeEvent(input$v_hi, leafletProxy("map") |> setView(-157.5, 20.5, 6))
  
  # Agencies that can't be placed on a state map (e.g. "Federal")
  output$unmapped <- renderText({
    off <- base() |>
      filter(!STATE_NAME %in% states_sf$NAME) |>
      group_by(STATE_NAME) |>
      summarise(n = sum(ACTUAL_COUNT), .groups = "drop")
    if (nrow(off) == 0) return("")
    paste0("Not on the map (all years): ",
           paste0(off$STATE_NAME, " (", fmt(off$n), " offenses)", collapse = ", "), ".")
  })
  
  selected <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  observeEvent(input$map_shape_click, selected(input$map_shape_click$id))
  
  detail_df <- reactive({
    req(selected())
    d <- filter(ht, STATE_NAME == selected())
    if (input$mode == "one") d <- filter(d, DATA_YEAR == input$year)
    d
  })
  
  output$detail_title <- renderText({
    if (is.null(selected())) return("Click a state on the map for details")
    period <- if (input$mode == "one") input$year else "all years"
    paste0(selected(), " (", period, ", all agency types and population groups)")
  })
  
  output$tbl_type <- renderTable({
    detail_df() |>
      group_by(`Agency type` = AGENCY_TYPE_NAME) |>
      summarise(Agencies = n_distinct(ORI),
                Offenses = sum(ACTUAL_COUNT),
                `Comm. Sex Acts` = sum(ACTUAL_COUNT[OFFENSE_SUBCAT_NAME == "Commercial Sex Acts"]),
                `Invol. Servitude` = sum(ACTUAL_COUNT[OFFENSE_SUBCAT_NAME == "Involuntary Servitude"]),
                .groups = "drop") |>
      arrange(desc(Offenses))
  }, striped = TRUE, digits = 0)
  
  output$tbl_pop <- renderTable({
    detail_df() |>
      group_by(Code = POPULATION_GROUP_CODE, Description = POPULATION_GROUP_DESC) |>
      summarise(Agencies = n_distinct(ORI),
                Offenses = sum(ACTUAL_COUNT),
                .groups = "drop") |>
      arrange(desc(Offenses))
  }, striped = TRUE, digits = 0)
  
  state_trend <- reactive({
    req(selected())
    filter(ht, STATE_NAME == selected())
  })
  
  output$plot_off <- renderPlot({
    state_trend() |>
      group_by(DATA_YEAR, OFFENSE_SUBCAT_NAME) |>
      summarise(offenses = sum(ACTUAL_COUNT), .groups = "drop") |>
      ggplot(aes(DATA_YEAR, offenses, color = OFFENSE_SUBCAT_NAME)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1) + geom_point() +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = years) +
      labs(title = "Offenses by year", x = NULL, y = "Actual count", color = NULL) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  })
  
  output$plot_ag <- renderPlot({
    state_trend() |>
      group_by(DATA_YEAR) |>
      summarise(agencies = n_distinct(ORI), .groups = "drop") |>
      ggplot(aes(DATA_YEAR, agencies)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 1) + geom_point() +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = years) +
      labs(title = "Agencies reporting by year", x = NULL, y = "Agencies") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```
